value.value: National Student Clearinghouse Research Center Enrollment Insights

National Student Clearinghouse Research Center Enrollment Insights provides postsecondary trend context,pathway context,enrollment benchmarks. It is a source or access layer, so causal effects must be taken from the underlying study records.
National Student Clearinghouse Research Center Enrollment Insights catalog metadata

## Catalog metadata

- **Steward:** National Student Clearinghouse Research Center
- **Access:** Public aggregate reports; student-level data require a separate research arrangement
- **Access URL:** https://nscresearchcenter.org/enrollment-insights/
- **Unit:** Aggregate enrollment and persistence reporting series
- **Coverage:** Report-series dependent
- **Update cadence:** Multiple releases per academic year
- **Geography:** nation, state, institution sector
- **Join keys:** term, state, institution sector, student group
- **Measures:** current enrollment, persistence, completion, transfer
- **Uses:** postsecondary trend context, pathway context, enrollment benchmarks

Aggregate public reporting is useful for context only; it cannot estimate the effect of a K-12 initiative on an individual student.

[Official resource](https://nscresearchcenter.org/enrollment-insights/)
